789-4279-5332--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
789-4279-5332--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen, Gutter Grime and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Gutter Grime ability, creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

579-3995-6723.easyPrerequisites: Horseshoe Crab doesn't have summoning sickness.
579-3995-6723.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}{U} due to Mana Reflection
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3764-7924-8095.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the Clue.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

141-1070-2511.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1070-2511.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

240-3899-5470-7730.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

1170-3581-5131-5226--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3581-5131-5226--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}.
Kykar and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

586-864-2034-3125-5632.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2034-3125-5632.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Chalk Outline.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and Clue token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2685-2919-4186-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-2919-4186-7810.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

3197-4017-6890-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-4017-6890-7810.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Repeat from step 2.

4399-4716-4770-6626.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Prosperous Innkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4716-4770-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

132-539-3899-4552-7704.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Myr Welder using Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat.

2921-3240-6462-7396.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

457-1409-3910.description:
Activate Breya by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Breya enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Breya
Resolve the Breya trigger, creating two artifact tokens
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping Breya and another artifact, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
457-1409-3910.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

198-1978-7280.manaNeeded: {1} if Empowered Autogenerator doesn't have a charge counter on it
198-1978-7280.description:
Animate Empowered Autogenerator using Donatello.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1636-6845-6972.notablePrerequisites: You are able to pay to cast Spider-Byte using any combination of mana-producing creatures and/or creatures that can reduce its cost using convoke.
1636-6845-6972.description:
Cast Spider-Byte by paying its mana cost reduced by the number of creatures you can tap while casting it.
When Spider-Byte enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Spider-Byte trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-6845-6972.notes: If you control mana-producing creatures, you can tap those creatures for mana instead of tapping them using the convoke ability.

1661-2464-3713-5078.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1661-2464-3713-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

967-2557-3809-5686-7087.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

uses.exileCardState: exiled by Steward of the Harvest

5200-6474-6984.notablePrerequisites: The creature with Sword of the Paruns attached does not have summoning sickness and has at least twelve charge counters on it. You control at least five creatures.
5200-6474-6984.notes: You can use Evendo, Waking Haven's station ability to put the charge counters on the creature. You can also notably use a Spacecraft for a similar effect. Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

2511-4375-5400.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Synth Infiltrator.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

67-2438-2781.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reveillark.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Reveillark.
When Reveillark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian and up to one other creature with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

602-3591-5436-6282.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a card.
Necropotence and Feast of Sanity trigger.
Resolve the Feast of Sanity trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Necropotence trigger, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Repeat.

1591-1878-2634-5195.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has four or more cards in hand.
1591-1878-2634-5195.description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying {2}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Jeska's Will.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Jeska's Will copy, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.
1591-1878-2634-5195.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of Jeska's Will's modes if desired.

856-5330-5631-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

511-817-1636-6206.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Fungi and/or Saprolings that do not have summoning sickness.
511-817-1636-6206.description:
Activate four Fungi and/or Saprolings by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}{G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

586-2906-5147-5258-5618.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

338-2060-3490-3910-4365.easyPrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Crystalline Crawler.
338-2060-3490-3910-4365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
338-2060-3490-3910-4365.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

2085-2136-4785.notablePrerequisites: You control a mana-producing permanent that can tap to produce at least {R}.
2085-2136-4785.description:
Activate Dynaheir by tapping it, copying the next non-mana ability you activate this turn that costs four or more mana.
Activate Kelpie Guide's first ability by tapping it, untapping Dynaheir.
Activate Dynaheir by tapping it, copying the next non-mana ability you activate this turn that costs four or more mana.
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, targeting Kelpie Guide.
Dynaheir triggers twice, copying Orthion's ability twice.
Resolve all Orthion triggers, creating fifteen token copies of Kelpie Guide with haste.
Activate a Kelpie Guide's first ability by tapping it, untapping a permanent that can tap to produce at least {R}.
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {R}.
Repeat from step 7 until you have at least {6}{R}{R}{R} available.
Activate two Kelpie Guides' first abilities by tapping them, untapping Dynaheir and Orthion.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Kelpie Guide tokens, you can use them to get infinite mana, and then activate Orthion targeting any other creature(s) you control.

uses.n: Growing Rites of Itlimoc // Itlimoc, Cradle of the Sun

1620-4067-4915.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.Cradle of the Sun.
1620-4067-4915.description:
Activate Itlimoc, Cradle of the Sun's second ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Bestial Bloodline, untapping Itlimoc.
Activate Bestial Bloodline by paying {4}{G}, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
If you control at least six creatures, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may untap any other permanent(s) using Mind over Matter.

3259-5159.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control a nonlegendary noncreature artifact.
3259-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary nooncreature artifact you control that is a 4/4 Construct named Mishra's Warform with haste.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Mishra's Warform token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

5111-5254-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with power four or greater.
5111-5254-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with power four or greater.
The creature dies, triggering Warbeast of Gorgoroth twice, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

586-2034-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Blitzwing, Cruel Tormentor // Blitzwing, Adaptive Assailant

4843-5008.notablePrerequisites:
Virtus does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Virtus.
4843-5008.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Virtus.
Virtus triggers, causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Blitzwing triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

46-1091.manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to cast the instant or sorcery from your hand
46-1091.notablePrerequisites: You have an instant or sorcery card in hand.
46-1091.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery spell.
Holding priority, cast Cooperate from your graveyard by paying {2}{U}.
Sevinne triggers, creating a copy of Cooperate, targeting Cooperate.
Resolve the copy of Cooperate, creating a copy of Cooperate, targeting Cooperate.
Repeat step 4.

1893-4050-4867.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and sorcery spells.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cormela, adding {1}.
Cormela dies, returning Shallow Grave from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Shallow Grave by paying {1}{B}, putting Cormela from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2713-2933-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, creating three 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
